verdict.line: You lose if you let Darius stack Hemorrhage and land Apprehend before level 6; you win if you stall the lane, bank Q stacks, and let armor items neutralize his burst after 11.

brief.thesis: Darius's kit is built to end trades fast: Hemorrhage stacks to an enrage, Apprehend (E) drags you into range, and Noxian Guillotine (R) finishes with true damage that ignores whatever you've itemized. Nasus has no comparable burst, so the matchup is decided by whether you fight on his terms or refuse them. The 48.9% win rate across 2,651 games matches a lane where Darius owns the early skirmishes but Nasus, if he stays patient, closes the gap by scaling Q (Siphoning Strike) and outlasting with Wither and tank items.

theirWindow.when: Apprehend is up and stacks are climbing
theirWindow.what: Do not stand within 535 range of him. He only needs one connected pull to chain Q (Decimate), autos, and Hemorrhage stacks into an enrage; back off and let him hit minions instead of you.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and trade freely with Q (Siphoning Strike) and drop E (Spirit Fire) on the wave. With no gap-close available for 16-26 seconds depending on his E rank, he can't punish you for stepping forward.

start.why: Sustains you through early autos and Decimate pokes while you farm Q stacks; it's the more-played start into Darius (49.9% WR, 1,735 games) over the Doran's Ring line.

boots.why: Darius's damage is almost entirely physical autos and Q hits, so flat armor plus the auto-attack damage reduction directly undercuts his all-in math (49.1% WR, 1,172 games).

core.why: Gives the damage and attack speed to actually threaten him back once your Q stacks come online.
Flat armor plus the attack speed slow directly blunts his enraged-passive auto chains.
Boosts your Soul Eater lifesteal and all incoming healing, which is what lets you out-sustain his bleed stacks over a long lane; this path has the best measured results (56.9% WR, 299 games).

situational.when: he gets an early kill and starts snowballing his passive-enraged autos
you're losing straight auto trades and need an early armor-plus-sustain spike
you want the extra slow and wave clear over a third damage item

runes.keystoneWhy: The move speed and sustain let you disengage the instant Apprehend is coming off cooldown, and the heal-on-hit keeps you even in extended poke exchanges where you can't out-trade him directly.

summoners.why: Ghost gives you the mobility to keep spacing outside his Apprehend range or disengage a committed all-in, and this combo has the highest measured win rate for the matchup (49.4%, 42.1% pick).

playing.title: Freeze outside Apprehend range
playing.detail: Keep your spacing beyond 535 units and only step in to last-hit with Q (Siphoning Strike, 255 range) once his E is confirmed down.

playing.title: Pop Wither the instant he commits
playing.detail: W (Wither) decelerates his Move and Attack Speed over time — use it the moment he lands Apprehend or flashes/ghosts in, not as a poke tool.

playing.title: Farm through Spirit Fire, not autos
playing.detail: Drop E (Spirit Fire) under the wave to shred armor and clear minions from range instead of trading autos into his Hemorrhage stacks.

playing.title: Disengage at 5 bleed stacks
playing.detail: His passive enrages for massive bonus AD at max Hemorrhage stacks — leave the trade the moment you see five stacks rather than continuing it.

playing.title: Respect Guillotine range at any stack lead
playing.detail: R (Noxian Guillotine, 460 range) is true damage and scales with his Hemorrhage stacks on you, so Spirit Visage lifesteal won't save a bad trade once he's level 6.

playing.title: Itemize armor early if you fall behind
playing.detail: If he gets first blood or an early kill, buy into the Frozen Heart or Thornmail path immediately rather than finishing Trinity Force first.

playing.title: Hold stacks, don't force fights
playing.detail: Once your Q stack count is clearly ahead, keep farming and avoid skirmishes — the lane win condition is a long, uneventful scaling period, not a kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from Darius’s Ghost and (E) ability. Focus on raising your [Q] stacks, and try to prolong the laning phase as much as possible.
